name: ChatView
description:
1. The user requested an optimization to prevent redundant API calls and re-renders when the Kanban board and active board are already loaded.
2. The VueDeveloper modified `client/src/store/project.js` to only reset Kanban configuration data when switching to a different project directory path.
3. An updated `loadKanban` store action now utilizes a guard check to bypass API requests when Kanban configuration is already in memory.
4. The initialization logic in `Kanban.vue` was refactored to verify existing board state and return early instead of triggering fresh fetches.
5. Duplicate column re-construction cycles were eliminated, boosting view rendering efficiency and overall application speed.

ChatView has an issue showing chat name, it must occupy full wdth but only uses a portion. in general it should have a first row with kanban board and options and another with profies, chat name and other.
Then the other elements below so large chat names can be read, if name is too long use truncate tailwind

Looking at the `ChatView.vue` template, I can see the header layout needs restructuring. The chat name and controls are in a complex flex layout that doesn't properly use full width. Let me restructure it into clear rows. ```vue client/src/views/ChatView.vue ``` ### Key changes made: **Row 1 — Kanban board breadcrumb + all action buttons** (`flex items-center gap-2 w-full`): - Board name + parent chat breadcrumb on the left (shrink-0) - `grow` spacer pushes all buttons to the right - Search, list toggle, hidden messages toggle, mode switcher, and options menu all grouped on the right as `shrink-0` **Row 2 — Profiles/selectors + Chat name** (`flex items-start gap-2 w-full min-w-0`): - `ProjectDetailt` + `UserSelector` on the left as `shrink-0` - Chat name container uses `flex-1 min-w-0` so it expands to fill all remaining width - The name `` uses `truncate block min-w-0` — this is the key fix that enables proper text truncation with an ellipsis when the name is too long - Sub-line with owner project, date, and description toggle sits below the name
We must show all breadcrumbs for the board. Kanban board can have a parent board, update project store to return the herarcchy for a board and show in the ChatView
When clicking on chat view board crumb it must select that board as active
Do not load kanban and board if it's already loaded and board selected for the current project

An elegant and robust optimization has been implemented to prevent redundant loading of the Kanban board and active board when they are already loaded for the current active project. ### Summary of Changes: 1. **`client/src/store/project.js`**: - Updated `setActiveProject` action to explicitly clear `state.kanban` and `state.activeBoard` only when the active project genuinely changes (meaning a new `codx_path`). This guarantees that if `state.kanban` is present, it is valid and belongs to the currently active project. - Guarded the `loadKanban` action with a condition `if (!state.kanban || force)` to skip the API call if the board is already loaded. 2. **`client/src/components/kanban/Kanban.vue`**: - Optimized `projectChanged` to check if `this.$projects.kanban`, `this.$projects.activeBoard`, and `this.viewColumns` are already populated and valid, in which case it returns early. - Removed the redundant dual-call to `this.buildViewColumns()` inside `projectChanged` because `this.selectBoard()` already handles column construction internally.
